chunks: Whoever dies in either of the two holy sanctuaries, Allah will resurrect him among the secure.

key_terms.أَحَدِ: one of; indicating either of the two mentioned sanctuaries
key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who resurrects and grants security
key_terms.الْآمِنِينَ: those who are secure; people granted safety
key_terms.الْحَرَمَيْنِ: the two sacred sanctuaries, namely Makkah and Madinah
key_terms.بَعَثَهُ: He will resurrect him; raise him on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.مَاتَ: died; referring to death occurring in a sacred place

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for one who dies in one of the two holy sanctuaries?
ai.summary: This hadith states that whoever dies in one of the two sacred sanctuaries will be raised by Allah among those who are secure. It highlights the spiritual merit of the two harams and the hopeful consequence associated with dying therein in the Hereafter.
